bailonz-street-13:

Others say the woman was suspected to be Ivy Sherwood, and the crowd scoffs: “That's even more impossible! Master Blackwood doesn't even spare a glance for stunning beauties, how could he possibly fall for an ugly woman?” That is, until someone sees the distinguished man kneeling to put a shoe on for Ivy Sherwood, all just to coax a kiss from her.…
your-lord-has-a-screw-loose:
The world was destroyed, the apocalypse descended, a new era began, and the right to survive as a Lord was granted to every person.
Domains, Heroes, Troops, Treasures, Resources—all of the countless servers constructed by the myriad continents were opened up.
Qin Muye looked at his panel, which was akin to cannon fodder, and his domain with its damaged suffix, and felt a strong urge to cry but no tears would come.
No divine talent, no hidden hints, no overpowered Profession.
“If that's the case, then I'll just have to adapt and live in a different way.”
